actions.name: frightening gaze
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fixes its gaze on [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=wmTdXl8uA71bwJeN]] it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=wmTdXl8uA71bwJeN]] of it. The target must succeed on a [[/save activity=wmTdXl8uA71bwJeN]] saving throw against this magic or become &reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=wmTdXl8uA71bwJeN]]. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: disrupt life
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Ro8ltLqMQLl16Qey]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: rejuvenation
actions.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). actions.name: turn resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
